title: LIBRARY & INFORMATION SCIENCE
utme_requirements:
WAEC, GCE[O/L], SSCE, NECO, NABTEB or equivalent with Credits in English Language, Mathematics, and any three subjects from the following:  History/Government, Civic Education, Economics, Commerce, Principles of Account, Literature in English, Fine Art, Physics, Chemistry,  Biology,  Basic Electricity,  Geography, Typewriting,  Photography, Computer Science, Music, Nigerian and International Language, Printing and Craft Practice, Radio/ Television and Electronics Works, Shorthand, Fine Art/Visual Art, Book Keeping, CRS/IRS, Cosmetology, Marketing, Agricultural Science/Animal Husbandry.

title: MASS COMMUNICATION
utme_requirements:
Five (5) SSC credit passes in English Language and Mathematics and any three (3) other subjects from:

History,

Literature in English,

Economics/Commerce,

Fine Arts,

Government,

Biology

Physics,

Chemistry

Basic Electricity

Geography,

Typewriting,

Commerce/Principles of Accounting.
subjects: Any three (3) subjects from Arts/Social Science/Physical Science.
remarks:
i) NIJ, IBD-POLY and OSUNPOLY require credit pass in Mathematics.

ii) NIJ, FEDPO-OKO and MAPA require five (5) 'O' Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings.

iii) IMT-ENU accepts 'O' Level credit passes in any of Chemistry, Physics, Biology, or Mathematics as one (1) of the credit requirements.

iv) LASPOTECH requires 'O' Level credit passes in a Physical Science subject and Geography. It also accepts Yoruba as course requirement.

v) KAD-POLY accepts Agricultural Science in lieu of Biology as course requirement.

vi) YABATECH requires five (5) O' Level credit passes in English Language and Mathematics , Literature in English and any two (2) other subjects from: History, Economics/Commerce, Fine Arts, Government, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Agric. Science, Geography, Typewriting, Principles of Accounting, Photography, Marketing and Yoruba/Hausa/Igbo.

vii) IBD-POLY requires three (3) other subjects from Geography, Yoruba, History, Government, IS/CRS and any Physical Science subject.

viii) AKPOLY accepts CRS and Principles of Accounts

ix) RUGIPO require 'O' Level credit passes in Literature in English Yoruba, CRS/IS. Also accepts 'O' Level pass in Mathematics.

x) FEDPO-FFA requires Literature in English as compulsory UTME subjects and any two (2) other subject from Yoruba/Igbo/Hausa, Commerce/ Economics/Government, Biology/Agricultural Science/ Geography, CRS/IS.

xi) FEDPO-NEK requires 'O' Level credit pass in one (1) Basic Science subject, and any two (2) from Government, Literature in English, Geography, Commerce, Economics, Igbo, CRS, Fine Arts, History, Information Communication Technology.

xii) OSUNPOLY accepts 'O' Level credit passes in CRS/IS, Yoruba, Civic Education/Government/History, Marketing/Economics/Commerce.

xiii) OGUN-POLY â€“ 'O' Level pass in Literature in English is accepted.

xiv) FIDEIPOLY requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes at not more than two sittings in the following subjects English Language, Mathematics and any three (3) from Literature in English, Economics, Commerce, Geography, Government, CRS, Fine Arts, History, and Information Communication Technology.

xv) FEDPO-NAS requires 'O' Level credit pass in Literature in English as part of course requirements.

xvi) AUCHIPOLY requires that the relevant number of 'O' Level credit passes should include English Language, Mathematics, and Literature in English.

xvii) KWA-POLY requires credit pass in Literature in English.

xviii) FEDPO-ILA requires 'O' credit passes in English Language (not Literature in English), Mathematics, and any three subjects from the following:  History, Economics/Commerce, Literature in English, Fine Art,  Government, Physics, Chemistry,  Biology,  Basic Electricity,  Geography, Typewriting,  Principles of Accounts, Photography, Computer Science, Music, Nigerian and International Language, Printing and Craft Practice, Radio/ Television and Electronics Works, Shorthand, Fine Art / Visual Art, Book Keeping, CRS/IS, Cosmetology, Marketing, Pass in Physics, Electronics/Basic Electricity will be an advantage. And Relevant NTC/NBC &NVC Trades.

xix) FEDPO-BAU requires â€˜Oâ€™ Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and any other three (3) subjects from History, Literature in English, Economics/Commerce, Fine Arts, Government, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Basic Electricity, Geography, Typewriting and Principles of Accounts.

 

UTME SUBJECTS

i) FEDPO-BAU requires any three (3) subjects from Sciences, Arts or Social Science.

ii) YABATECH requires Literature in English, Economics and Government/History

title: BUILDING TECHNOLOGY

WAEC, GCE [O/L], SSCE, NECO, NABTEB or equivalent with Credits in English Language, Mathematics, Physics and any two subjects from the following: Economics, Building Construction, Technical Drawing/Graphics Design, Civic Education, Carpentry and Joinery, Plumbing and Pipe Fitting, Painting and Decoration, Wood Work, Computer Studies, Chemistry, Biology, Geography, Further Mathematics, Religious Knowledge,  Metal Work, Upholstery, Basic Electronics, Introduction to Building Construction, Financial Accounting, Draughtsmanship/Graphic Design, Machine Woodworking, Computer Craft Studies, Furniture Making, Electrical Installation & Maintenance Work, Welding and Fabrication. 

A Pass in Technical Drawing and or Building Construction will be an advantage
subjects: English Language, Mathematics, Physics and one subject from: Chemistry, Geography, Economics, Technical Drawing and Building Construction

title: TAXATION

subjects: English Language, Mathematics and two (2) of Geography, Commerce, Government, Principles of Accounts and Economics
